title: Short-Term Demand Sensing

blueprintSignals.name: Open order book
blueprintSignals.definition: confirmed orders not yet shipped by SKU
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Take the snapshot as it stood at forecast time

blueprintSignals.name: Sell-through momentum
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Align calendar days across the two windows

blueprintSignals.name: External event signal
blueprintSignals.definition: weather, strikes, promotions known in advance
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use the forecast published at the origin, not the observed value

blueprintSignals.name: Planned promotion flag
blueprintSignals.definition: whether the target day sits inside a scheduled promotion
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: The flag must be the plan as of the origin, not the promotion as finally run

blueprintSignals.name: Same-weekday history
blueprintSignals.definition: mean of the last two or three same-weekday sales before the origin
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Only same weekdays that fall on or before the origin day may be used

label: For "Short-Term Demand Sensing": Blend point-of-sale, order and external signals into 1-14 day demand forecasts that react to what is actually happening this week. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training with signals that arrive after the forecast time.
